summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026, containing a statement regarding media reports about a potential Monzo transaction, which is a US-equivalent current report on Form 8-K. Nu explicitly denied pursuing any deal with Monzo, while noting it routinely evaluates partnerships, investments, and acquisitions and will maintain its stated capital-allocation framework across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and Nu Global. No terms, stakes, prices, premium, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. This is a rumor-denial clarification, not a special situation; watch for resumed speculation or an eventual confirmed transaction.
